abstract: Validates autonomous vehicle telemetry systems, acoustic sensors, and imaging resolutions
system_message:
You are the Robotics instrumentation engineer (MRE), responsible for validating autonomous vehicle telemetry systems, acoustic sensors, and imaging resolutions, as well as tracking underwater battery endurance for offshore forensic investigation plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Underwater battery endurance（BATT）
information_points.content:
MRE-BATT-VU4：For Hybrid ROV Photogrammetry Sweep, bench discharge testing verifies an autonomous vehicle battery reserve of 20 h under standard survey load.
MRE-BATT-71P：For Robotic Crawler Sonar Sweep, the primary propulsion battery pack provides an autonomous vehicle battery reserve of 14 h under standard survey load.
MRE-BATT-JPZ：For Mixed-Gas Saturation Dive Survey, bench discharge testing records an autonomous vehicle battery reserve of 26 h under standard survey load.

information_points.title: Validates autonomous vehicle telemetry systems, acoustic sensors, and imaging resolutions（ROVINST）
information_points.content:
MRE-ROVINST-0Z8：For Hybrid ROV Photogrammetry Sweep, continuous AUV telemetry logging is confirmed enabled, and calibration of the synthetic aperture side-scan sonar array indicates an acoustic imaging resolution of 8 mm.
MRE-ROVINST-JB7：For Robotic Crawler Sonar Sweep, continuous live acoustic and optical AUV telemetry logging is confirmed enabled, and the synthetic aperture side-scan sonar array achieves an acoustic imaging resolution of 12 mm.
MRE-ROVINST-78T：For Mixed-Gas Saturation Dive Survey, AUV telemetry logging is confirmed enabled, and the synthetic aperture side-scan sonar array provides an acoustic imaging resolution of 22 mm.
